Here's the modified formula to write results to AB26:NW35:

=CMPGetResults(IF(AC6="Base",Z6,Z7),AE6&"_values","varray",TRUE,"row_offset",2,"col_offset",-1,"col_start",AJ6,"col_limit",AK6,"start_cell","AB26","end_cell","NW35")

The key changes are:
- Added "start_cell","AB26" to specify the starting cell
- Added "end_cell","NW35" to specify the ending cell

These additional parameters will redirect the results to the range AB26:NW35 instead of the original range.
